title: fix(console): a stored settings select, radio or multiselect value the setting no longer offers reads as "no longer available"
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu3zQ2AqeghSGpv6Q7VEPDyQ)_

Fixes #37480

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Ruling record for the card's second half: comment 7190223182 on #37480 (the maintainer chose B, 「维持现状，只写文档」: stored rows stay, the manual removal path is documented). No server code changes.

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在设置页看下拉框、单选组或多选组时,如果之前保存的选项已被新版本移除,原来显示空白或一个都没选中,现在显示为「原值(已不可用)」。
- 属于知识库适配器下线后的善后:替保存过已下线选项的管理员解决「看不出配置了什么」的问题。
- 出错时最多是这一项显示不对,保存行为不变,可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- **Console settings select** (`SettingsField.tsx`, the closed `select` arm without `valueDomain`): when the stored value is non-empty and not among the field's current `options`, the list gets one disabled item for that code, labelled with the new locale key `console.settingsView.selectValueRetired` (`VALUE (no longer available)`). Radix shows the selected item's text, so the trigger now names the stored code instead of reading blank. Picking a current option is an ordinary declared-key write; the retired item cannot be picked back. Values among the options and an unset value render as before.
- **Console settings radio** (the `radio` arm of the same file): the same condition adds one disabled `RadioGroupItem` for the stored code, first in the group and checked (the group's value is the stored code), labelled with the same key. Chosen over a read-only line beside the group so the group itself says what is stored; the current options stay enabled.
- **Console settings multiselect** (the `multiselect` arm): each stored array member outside `options` gets one checked checkbox, first in the grid, labelled with the same key. Measured save behaviour: ticking a current option builds the next array from the whole stored array (unchanged from before), so the retired member stays in what is saved, exactly as it did while it was invisible; the server refuses a write of that key while the array holds a value outside the options (`invalid_option`, `settings-service.ts` option check over `select`/`radio`/`multiselect`), as it already did. So the retired checkbox is deliberately NOT disabled: unticking it removes the member from the array (the way to make the field saveable again), and once removed it leaves the list and cannot be ticked back. A disabled checkbox would have left the field unsaveable with no way out.
- **Locale key** `console.settingsView.selectValueRetired` in all eleven `@object-ui/i18n` packs (real translations). The Console's settings strings live in `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*`, so that is where the key goes (the claim's "Console locale bundles").
- **Docs** (`content/docs/protocol/kernel/config-resolution.mdx`, new `### Retired keys and options` under *Secrets*): rows stored for a removed key or option are kept, unused, never deleted; an encrypted key's `sys_secret` row stays; Setup shows a non-option value as "no longer available"; removal by hand is deleting the key's row from `sys_platform_setting` (global-scope manifest) or `sys_setting`, plus the `sys_secret` row its `value_enc` names. This is the ruling's documentation half; it touches none of PR #37477's files.
- Changeset `.changeset/37480-settings-retired-option.md` (`@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/i18n`, patch).

Read first: `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx` (the `retired` computation and the extra `SelectItem` / `RadioGroupItem` / retired checkboxes), then the new test.

Two-minute check: `cd ui/apps/console && pnpm exec vitest run --root ../.. --project @object-ui/console src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsField.retiredOption-37480.test.tsx` — expect 10 passed.

## Tests

- New `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsField.retiredOption-37480.test.tsx` renders the real `SettingsField`: stored `ragflow` outside the options reads `ragflow (no longer available)` under en and the zh-pack text under zh-CN; controls: a stored value among the options reads its label with no retired item, and no value still reads the placeholder. Radio: stored `ragflow` gives a checked, disabled radio named `ragflow (no longer available)` while `Dify` stays enabled and unchecked; control: stored `dify` checks its own item, two radios, no retired item. Multiselect: stored `['ragflow','dify']` shows a checked `ragflow (no longer available)` checkbox beside a checked `Dify`; ticking `Dify` over stored `['ragflow']` sends `['ragflow','dify']` (pins the unchanged keep-on-save); unticking the retired one sends `['dify']`; control: members all among the options draw only the two option checkboxes.
- Ablation: with the select arm's `retired` condition forced false on disk, the two select named-state cases fail and the controls pass; with the radio arm's forced false, only the radio named-state case fails (1 failed, 5 passed); with the multiselect arm's forced false, its named-state and untick cases fail (2 failed, 8 passed) while the keep-on-save pin passes, as it pins existing behaviour; each restored with `git checkout HEAD --`.

## Acceptance notes

- The `radio` arm is in scope (the card's done-when covers every control that shows a stored option value) and gets the same named state in this PR. The `multiselect` arm gets the named state too, untickable for the reason under What changes. Clearing a retired member server-side is not in this PR (ruling 7190223182 keeps stored rows).
- The second half of the card (clearing an undeclared key or its `sys_secret` row from a settings door) is decided as "keep, document" by the ruling above.

## Verification

Head `ec4e9149bb`. Local, targeted (the full farm is CI's):

<details><summary>Console settings tests</summary>

- `vitest run --project @object-ui/console src/pages/settings/` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0): Test Files 45 passed (45), Tests 498 passed (498).
- Ablations: select arm 2 failed, 2 passed (4) on the first head; radio arm 1 failed, 5 passed (6); multiselect arm 2 failed, 8 passed (10); restored.
</details>

<details><summary>i18n package</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n test`: Test Files 111 passed (111), Tests 2028 passed, 13 skipped.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families</summary>

- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived set run locally; per-command exit codes are in the report comment on the card. `check:skill-examples` client-SDK surface: NOT MEASURED locally (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, client-react dist has no declarations; this diff adds no TypeScript example). Console `type-check` is left to CI's `Type Check UI` (needs every `@object-ui` package built).
</details>
